column1: # Source page per project thumbnail, for scripts/capture-project-shots.sh
#   <slug><TAB><url>[<TAB>flags]
# flags: comma-separated. "insecure" bypasses TLS validation (expired/self-signed
# cert), "delay=N" waits N seconds before shooting.
# Slugs must match the `slug:` front matter key in the matching _projects/ file.
# Local URLs need their dev server running first — see the comments below.
iapuru
carlota
criarjingles
# Jopoia: the live host sits behind HTTP Basic auth, so shoot the local prototype.
#   cd ~/Trabalhos-git/jopoi && pnpm dev        # serves apps/ on :3000
jopoia
# Forma Infinita: not deployed — no DNS for formainfinita.com.br.
#   cd ~/Trabalhos-git/formainfinita && pnpm install && pnpm dev
# Jekyll already owns :4000, so serve the web app elsewhere:
#   pnpm --filter @forma/web exec next dev --port 4010
formainfinita
# Beacon Manager: no thumbnail yet — the admin panel needs Postgres, migrations
# and a seeded user with 2FA before it renders anything but a login screen, and a
# login screen is not a portfolio thumbnail. Its _projects/ file carries an empty
# `image:` until there is a real panel screenshot to put here. Uncomment and shoot
# once the stack is up on a port that does not collide with Jopoia's :3000.
#   cd ~/Trabalhos-git/Beacon-Manager && docker compose up -d && pnpm dev
# beacon-manager
